demo.question: What can a 10 m mast at 1.3546, 103.7764 see within 3 km?

plan.explanation: Work out what a 10 m observer at 48N UG 6387 4975 can see within 3 km, from the Copernicus 30 m elevation model (it includes buildings and trees).

steps: Reading the Copernicus GLO-30 DEM within 3 km
Tracing sight lines from a 10 m observer to 2 m targets
demo.answer: A 10 m observer here can see about 1589 ha (56%) of the ground within 3 km. Buildings and trees in the 30 m elevation model block views; small obstacles are missed.
